hazard-classes-addressed.probed: Verified that family is derived from kernel observation of served model (src/review.ts:546), not from any verdict field. The executor observes the model from the stream's assistant rows, and familyOf is called on that observation. Verdict's optional produced-by field is history only (schema allows it, no reader references it). Test m6-p5-family-red verifies two records with same family are red without exception.
hazard-classes-addressed.cleared-because: Family is the vendor from observed model; a family from verdict field cannot happen.

hazard-classes-addressed.probed: Confirmed hand-written records are refused: only JSON under delivery/review/records/ is parsed as a record (src/review.ts:668-678). A verdict dropped there is neither a record (wrong content) nor counted (verdict loader skips records/). Test m6-p5-record-verdict-apart stages a stray verdict in records/ and a stray record beside verdicts; only the real record counts.
hazard-classes-addressed.cleared-because: Only valid JSON records under delivery/review/records/ count; hand-written files in other forms are not valid records.

hazard-classes-addressed.cleared-because: Failed observation returns null model in record; no fallback to requested model. Uncounted by merge gate.

hazard-classes-addressed.probed: Verified verdict SHA256 is recomputed and stored: kernel reads verdict bytes after executor exits, computes SHA256, stores in record.verdict.sha256 (src/review.ts:556-558).
